summary: HTTP order service with user-scoped orders and lookup by id. Callers authenticate via X-User-Id; list is filtered by owner, but detail lookup does not re-check ownership.
trustBoundaries: authenticated caller → order detail by id
process memory → order records (no external DB)
assumptions: X-User-Id is treated as the authenticated principal (no session store).
Agents only see cases/<id>/app — truth.json is scorer-only.
IDOR risk concentrates on getOrder / GET /orders/:id.
openQuestions: Is there any secondary ownership check after Map lookup?
Do smoke tests assert cross-user denial on detail?
